scenario.title: A Sudden Change of Plans
scenario.context: A social gathering at a local park during a sunny afternoon. Families are picnicking, children are playing, and a jazz band is performing in the gazebo.
scenario.description: Speaker 1, Wendy, has been looking forward to attending a friend's wedding overseas. However, she recently found out that she's pregnant and won't be able to travel. She's sharing this news with her best friend, Speaker 2, Alex, at the park gathering.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Excited about her pregnancy, yet disappointed about missing the wedding. She's calm, expressive and open about her feelings.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - He is understanding, comforting and empathetic, expressing genuine happiness for her pregnancy while acknowledging her disappointment about the wedding.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - He is dismissive and insensitive, focusing only on her missing the wedding and disregarding her feelings about her pregnancy.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - He is overexcited and overbearing, focusing solely on her pregnancy and ignoring her disappointment about missing the wedding.
scenario.speaker2_persona_high: High EQ - He is understanding, comforting and empathetic, expressing genuine happiness for her pregnancy while acknowledging her disappointment about the wedding.
scenario.speaker2_persona_low: Low EQ - He is dismissive and insensitive, focusing only on her missing the wedding and disregarding her feelings about her pregnancy.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Hey Alex, you know how excited I was for Tania's wedding in Italy? Well, I won't be able to go.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Oh no, Wendy. What happened? Are you okay?

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Yeah, I'm fine. I'm actually pregnant, can you believe that? So, no traveling for me.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Wow, that's huge news, Wendy! I'm sorry you can't make it to the wedding, but congratulations on the baby!

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Thank you, Alex. It's a lot to process, but I'm excited about the baby too.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: You're going to be an amazing mom, Wendy. And don't worry about the wedding, we'll make sure to bring you back some cannoli!
